Produced from an amalgamation of various Militech weapon parts by Hansen Armory. The ideal compromise between quality and price - a weapon that won't fail during a firefight, nor drain your wallet.Its short, compact barrel allows you to fire a quick and deadly salvo from the hip, while the long magazine lends the gun a balanced feel. With the HA-4 Grit, you can confidently leap into action.

Cost: 750eb (Expensive)

Class: Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Snubnose Pistol

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: 30 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Pistol 3), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Pistol Autosear, Pistol Snub Barrel, Tech Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: This weapon’s Tech Rebuild cannot see or fire through cover, and while charged it is only capable of using Autofire.

Range: Snubnose Pistol
Pre-installed: Pistol Autosear, Pistol Snub Barrel, Tech Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Pistol 3), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
